contract.choice_basis: Earliest causal response: one issued command and two observed joint positions. Fixed before fitting; no window sweep.
contract.classifier: unscaled nearest centroid; no feature search or confidence fitting
contract.internal_validation: four folds, hold both conditions of one training start out together
contract.exclusion_reason: composite action does not label a single immediate controller
contract.condition_default_rule: Rank complete four-start eligible controllers by mean whole-episode quality, then action index; no default when none is complete.
